import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.LineBundleRationalSections
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.ModuleGlobalGeneration

/-!
# Regular sections of a line bundle on an integral scheme

A nonzero global section of a line bundle is regular. Rational coordinates
reduce injectivity to cancellation by a nonzero element of the function field.
This supplies the regular section needed to bound the support of the divisor
Grassmannian candidate on an integral fibre.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LineBundle

variable {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- A nonzero global section of a line bundle on an integral scheme defines
a monomorphism from the structure sheaf. -/
theorem mono_homOfGlobalSection
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    @Mono X.Modules _ _ _ (Modules.homOfGlobalSection L s) := by
  have hq : rationalSection L hL ⊤ trivial s ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hs (rationalSection_injective L hL ⊤ trivial
      (h.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  have hinj : ∀ U : X.Opens,
      Function.Injective ((Modules.homOfGlobalSection L s).app U) := by
    intro U a b hab
    by_cases hU : (U : Set X).Nonempty
    · have hηU : genericPoint X ∈ U :=
        ((genericPoint_spec X).mem_open_set_iff U.isOpen).mpr (by simpa using hU)
      apply AlgebraicGeometry.germ_injective_of_isIntegral X (genericPoint X) hηU
      apply mul_right_cancel₀ hq
      have heq := congrArg (rationalSection L hL U hηU) hab
      simpa only [Modules.homOfGlobalSection_app, rationalSection_smul,
        rationalSection_restrict] using heq
    · exact (Modules.isSheaf (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).section_ext
        (fun x hx => (hU ⟨x, hx⟩).elim)
  constructor
  intro M f g h
  ext U r
  apply hinj U
  change (f ≫ Modules.homOfGlobalSection L s).app U r =
    (g ≫ Modules.homOfGlobalSection L s).app U r
  rw [h]

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Every nonzero morphism from the structure sheaf to a line bundle on an
integral scheme is a monomorphism. -/
theorem mono_unit_hom_of_ne_zero
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : IsLocallyTrivial L)
    (s : (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf : X.Modules) ⟶ L)
    (hs : s ≠ 0) : @Mono X.Modules _ _ _ s := by
  let t : Γ(L, ⊤) := Modules.Hom.app s ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))
  have heq : Modules.homOfGlobalSection L t = s := by
    apply L.unitHomEquiv.injective
    refine PresheafOfModules.sections_ext _ _ fun U => ?_
    have hnat := (L.unitHomEquiv s).property
      (homOfLE (show U.unop ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op
    simp only [Modules.homOfGlobalSection, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hnat
  have ht : t ≠ 0 := by
    intro ht
    apply hs
    rw [← heq]
    apply L.unitHomEquiv.injective
    refine PresheafOfModules.sections_ext _ _ fun U => ?_
    simp only [Modules.homOfGlobalSection, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, ht]
    change L.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show U.unop ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op 0 = 0
    exact map_zero _
  rw [← heq]
  exact mono_homOfGlobalSection L hL t ht

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.LineBundle
